key_insight: Sampling one bitline twice through the same comparator cancels device offset and removes reference bitlines, so sloppy TFT or 180 nm devices could sense.
killer_doubt: Each read costs an extra write plus a restore (~3x tRC, ~2x array energy). Auto-zero and offset-cancelling sense amps already cancel 20-50 mV mismatch without the extra write (N-27).
decisive_experiment: SPICE plus a 180 nm MPW test array: compare self-reference with auto-zero (N-27) on sense margin, tRC and energy per read, at 50 mV injected offset, on 1T1C and IGZO cells. ~$150k.
prior_art: MRAM destructive self-reference sensing (Jeong et al., JSSC 2003); offset-cancellation DRAM sense amps; study N-27 auto-zero TFT sense amps [training knowledge].

key_insight: Append-only KV streams let dedicated mats trade random row access for sequential access, so the row path could be drawn at relaxed DUV pitch.
killer_doubt: Sub-wordline drivers, not predecoders, dominate row periphery. A flip-flop per 8 wordlines is larger than a predecoded NAND gate, so the saving is a few % of die (estimate).
decisive_experiment: Layout study in a 28 nm PDK: predecoded row decoder versus a shift-register token chain at 8-wordline pitch. Replay vLLM paged-attention traces to measure how often block-granular access suffices. ~$50k.
prior_art: LCD gate-on-array shift-register gate drivers; VRAM serial-access ports and FIFO memories [training knowledge].

key_insight: One etch and one decoder serving N stacked memory layers per crosspoint attacks the masks-per-deck cost that kept Optane from scaling.
killer_doubt: With one current through all 8 series layers, layer k cannot be written alone. GeSe OTS loses nonlinearity near 1e6 cycles, versus ~1e13 for DRAM (via search snippet).
decisive_experiment: On a university line, deposit a 2-layer OTS/self-selecting stack with distinct thresholds. Test whether either layer programs alone, measure Vth sigma against window spacing, and read disturb over 1e6 ramp reads. ~$250k.
prior_art: Intel/Micron 3D XPoint; Micron and SK hynix self-selecting / selector-only chalcogenide memory; multi-level PCM [training knowledge]. No stacked multi-window OTS found.

key_insight: A hysteretic threshold-switch plus capacitor cell, latched by a global AC sustain, needs no access transistor or refresh controller: plasma-display wall-charge memory moved to crosspoints.
killer_doubt: Sustain re-fires every '1' each cycle. OTS off-current of 1 pA-1 nA (13 fA tail) drains 1 fF in 0.1-100 us, so sustain burns ~20 W-20 kW/Gb (estimate).
decisive_experiment: Single-cell bench test: an OTS in series with a 10-100 fF MIM capacitor under AC sustain. Measure the bistable window, hold time between pulses, and Ioff after 1e9 fires. ~$100k.
prior_art: AC plasma display panel memory effect (wall charge); selector-only chalcogenide memory [training knowledge]. A threshold-switch/capacitor sustain RAM was not found.

key_insight: Collapsing capacitance at constant charge gives ~5x voltage gain before the latch from silicon and oxide alone, relaxing sense-amp offset without matched gain transistors.
killer_doubt: Common mode is amplified too: ~0.5 V CM x 5 gain x 2% varactor C-V mismatch is ~50 mV offset, giving back the saving. N-04 charge-transfer presensing already supplies gain.
decisive_experiment: 28-65 nm MPW: varactor-pair preamps on a 512-cell bitline replica. Measure input-referred offset sigma, kT/C noise and gain spread, compared with charge-transfer presensing (N-04). ~$150k.
prior_art: MOS-varactor discrete-time parametric amplifiers (Ranjbar/Oliaei, JSSC); charge-transfer presensing DRAM; study N-04 [training knowledge].

key_insight: Charge packets shifting up the tiers to one floating-diffusion node remove per-tier decoders and staircase contacts, which are the line-end cost of 3D arrays.
killer_doubt: It duplicates imec's IGZO 3D CCD. CIS fabs lack 3D-NAND tier stacks, and a poly-Si channel has ~1e3-1e5x c-Si dark current, giving ms-class retention at 85 C (estimate).
decisive_experiment: No separate experiment; fold into I-10793. If pursued, compare poly-Si with IGZO 8-tier vertical CCD strings at 85 C, measuring dark generation and per-transfer CTE. ~$300k.
prior_art: imec IGZO CCD buffer memory: planar at IEDM 2024, 3D at IMW 2026 (via search snippet, prior logs); 1970s CCD memories; study N-08.

key_insight: Recirculating through a regenerating floating-diffusion node makes refresh a by-product of reading, and one sense node per 512 bits approaches NAND periphery economics.
killer_doubt: 512 packets x 3 phases is ~1,536 transfers. imec's >98% CTE leaves ~0% of the charge, and even 0.9999 leaves 86%. 10-50 us access is NAND-class, not DRAM-class.
decisive_experiment: Measure per-transfer CTE against clock frequency on a 32-tier IGZO vertical CCD test string, then extrapolate the maximum string length at 1e-15 BER. Shared with I-10793. ~$300k.
prior_art: imec IGZO 3D CCD (IMW 2026) and planar 142-bit device (IEDM 2024) (via search snippet, prior logs); 1970s recirculating CCD memories (Intel, Fairchild).

key_insight: Looped or bidirectional shifting past one regenerating amp per 64-128-tier string resets transfer loss on every pass with no per-tier access transistor: the 1970s CCD-memory refresh loop moved into oxide.
killer_doubt: 128 tiers x 3 phases is 384 transfers. imec's >98% CTE keeps ~0.04%, and ≥0.9999 is needed. At the demonstrated ~6 MHz clocks one pass takes ~60 us.
decisive_experiment: Fabricate 16- and 64-tier IGZO vertical CCD strings with a regenerating latch at the base. Measure CTE against clock (1-500 MHz) and bit errors after 1e6 recirculations at 85 C. ~$400k.
prior_art: Intel 2416 and Fairchild CCD memories (recirculating loops with refresh amplifiers); imec IGZO 3D CCD (IMW 2026) (via search snippet, prior logs). Merge into I-10793.

key_insight: Detecting zeros at the sense stripe, before global I/O, saves both internal datapath and pin energy on all-zero sectors; controller-side compression saves only pin energy.
killer_doubt: Whole all-zero 64 B sectors are rare. At 90% element sparsity only 0.9^32 = 3.4% of BF16 sectors are all-zero, and paged KV caches avoid padding.
decisive_experiment: Trace study: measure the fraction of all-zero 64-byte sectors in LLM inference activation, KV and gradient traffic (vLLM, PyTorch), and model the energy saved with DRAMPower. ~$30k, weeks.
prior_art: LPDDR5 Write-X pattern writes; NVIDIA A100 compute data compression for sparse data; zero-content augmented caches (Dusser et al., 2009) [training knowledge].

key_insight: Deposition-defined stacking on 3D-NAND tools is the known route to ~10x cheaper bits without EUV. Reusing NAND tool sets turns existing capital into DRAM-class capacity.
killer_doubt: A 2T0C needs two independently gated devices per bit; a NAND-style series string gives no per-tier random access. Uniform IGZO Vt (σ ≤ 20 mV) across 300+ tiers is unshown.
decisive_experiment: On a university 8-tier oxide/nitride mold, build vertical-channel IGZO 2T0C cells with string-select access. Measure per-tier random read/write, Vt sigma across tiers, and 85 C retention. ~$500k.
prior_art: NEO 3D X-DRAM PoC on a 3D-NAND process (May 2026, via search snippet, prior log); Kioxia OS-DRAM; Macronix 3D AND; Samsung/SK hynix 3D DRAM; N-28.

key_insight: New DRAM technologies die in the demand-risk valley. A tech-neutral pull commitment pays only for delivered bits that meet $/GB, latency and endurance thresholds, so it backs whichever cell wins.
killer_doubt: 10 EB at ~$20/GB is ~$200B; a fundable first tranche is ~$1-5B (0.05-0.25 EB). SEMI's July 2026 letter opposes government memory-market intervention and favours long-term contracts.
decisive_experiment: Draft an AMC term sheet (thresholds, price taper, JEDEC-style qualification) and secure non-binding letters from 3 hyperscalers and 1 federal buyer for a $1B pilot tranche. ~$300k, 12 months.
prior_art: Gavi pneumococcal AMC (2009) and Frontier carbon-removal AMC (2022) [training knowledge]. No memory AMC found; SEMI urges long-term contracts instead (via search snippet).

key_insight: An 'AI-grade' bit: protect sign and exponent, tolerate mantissa errors and map defects at boot, so tall low-yield thin-film stacks ship instead of being scrapped. Re-scope: no 100x claim.
killer_doubt: 3D-stack defects are clustered (tier shorts, dead lines), not iid, and one shorted tier kills a block. An unprotected exponent-MSB flip turns 1.0 into ~1e38.
decisive_experiment: Inject clustered fault maps at 1e-3 raw BER into Llama-class inference with exponent-only ECC. Use maps from a 3D oxide test stack or published DRAM error logs. Report perplexity and recovered compound yield. ~$80k.
prior_art: EDEN approximate DRAM for DNNs (Koppula et al., MICRO 2019); Flikker (2011) [training knowledge]; study N-65 significance split, N-34 defect budget, N-55 spare tiers.
